خُصْلَةٌ A لَفِيفَة, (S,) [i. e.] a lock, or flock, (PS,) or a plexus, (KL,) or a quantity collected [or hanging] together, (K,) of hair, (S, K, KL, PS,) and of wool, (PS, and S and K in art. جز,) &c.: (PS:) or a small quantity of hair; as also ↓ خَصِيلَةٌ , (K,) as in the M: pl. خُصَلٌ. (TA.) ―
-b2- See also خَصْلَةٌ, in two places. ―
-b3- Also A portion of flesh forming a distinct limb or member or organ (عُضْوٌ مِنَ اللَّحْمِ). (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
